name: Sunlite Recycling Industries Ltd (SUNLITE)
tagline: Micro-cap copper-recycling manufacturer (copper rods/wires/earthing products from scrap) with exceptional headline growth and returns (ROE/ROCE ~35%+, revenue +107% YoY latest quarter), but a forum peer-thread caution flags it as a commodity play lacking value-addition moat.
business_overview: Sunlite Recycling Industries (founded 2012, listed via IPO Aug 2024) manufactures copper rods, wires, earthing conductors and strips from recycled copper scrap, serving power generation/transmission/distribution and electronics-industry customers - a circular-economy / import-substitution play on copper demand. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@JakeraChoudhury, Sept 2026) as a bullish, medium-conviction view.
fundamentals_table: Long-run avg ~57%/yr; Q3 FY26 +107% YoY (76% volume growth)
IPO Aug 2024 (Rs 199.50 listing, ~90% premium to issue price)
fundamentals_narrative: On paper this is a standout micro-cap: ROE/ROCE both in the mid-30s%, revenue growing ~57%/yr on average and accelerating to +107% YoY (76% volume growth) in the most recent quarter reported, with debt almost negligible (D/E ~8%). The catch, surfaced via a ValuePickr forum search, is a specific and directly relevant caution: a forum user (RocketMan, in the Bhagyanagar India - Copper Recycling Play thread, May 2026) explicitly said he had rotated OUT of Sunlite Recycling after concluding 'value addition is extremely important - you cannot rely purely on commodity sales,' i.e. a moat concern that Sunlite's economics may be more commodity-cyclical (copper scrap spreads) than a durable, value-added business. No dedicated Sunlite thread exists on ValuePickr; this is a peer-thread mention only.
